page.title: Hosting plans for small teams
page.description: Pick a hosting plan that fits a small team, with backups and support included.

findings.title: Page has almost no text without JavaScript
findings.evidence: 13 words of text in the HTML before JavaScript runs
findings.fix: Pre-render or server-render the page so its content is in the HTML; most AI crawlers do not run JavaScript. Mark sign-in and app-only pages noindex instead.

findings.title: No canonical URL
findings.fix: Add <link rel="canonical" href="https://…"> with the page's absolute URL.

findings.title: No structured data
findings.evidence: 1 of 1 pages have no JSON-LD: https://example.com/plans
findings.fix: Add JSON-LD describing the organisation and the page (Organization, WebSite, Service, Article…).

generated.code:
<script type="application/ld+json">
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "WebPage",
  "description": "Pick a hosting plan that fits a small team, with backups and support included.",
  "name": "Hosting plans for small teams",
  "url": "https://example.com/plans"
}
</script>

findings.title: No link preview image
findings.fix: Add <meta property="og:image" content="https://…"> with an absolute URL of an image at least 1200×630 pixels, such as the page's featured image.

findings.title: No X (Twitter) card tag
findings.evidence: 1 of 1 pages have no twitter:card tag: https://example.com/plans
findings.fix: Add <meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">; X reads title, description and image from the og: tags, but shows no card without twitter:card.

findings.title: No x-default language version
findings.evidence: 1 of 1 pages with hreflang have no x-default: https://example.com/plans
findings.fix: Optional: add hreflang="x-default" pointing at the page for visitors whose language is not listed.

findings.title: Page has little text
findings.evidence: 1 of 1 pages have fewer than 100 words of visible text: https://shop.example.com/blog/pricing-guide (7 words)
findings.fix: Expand the page with useful content, merge it into a related page, or mark it noindex; a page under 100 words rarely answers a search on its own.

findings.title: Page links to no other page on the site
findings.evidence: 1 of 1 pages link to no other page on the site: https://shop.example.com/blog/pricing-guide
findings.fix: Add links to related pages; a page without them is a dead end for visitors and crawlers.

findings.title: Images without alt text
findings.evidence: 1 of 1 pages have images without alt: https://shop.example.com/blog/pricing-guide (1 of 1 images)
findings.fix: Describe each meaningful image in alt; use alt="" for decorative ones.

findings.title: Images without width and height
findings.evidence: 1 of 1 pages have images without width and height: https://shop.example.com/blog/pricing-guide (1 of 1 images)
findings.fix: Set width and height on so the layout does not shift while loading.
